en: The image depicts the interior of a historic church, focusing on an ornate altar. The altar is framed by an arch with religious iconography, including angels and a depiction of Christ on the cross above a globe. There are several candlesticks and religious statues on the altar. Benches for worshippers are visible in the foreground. The walls are decorated with religious paintings and inscriptions in Latin.
